SourceProxy.name: PointCoordinatesToScalars
SourceProxy.label: Point Coordinates To Scalars

Documentation.short_help: Generate X/Y/Z scalar arrays from point coordinates for coloring.
Documentation.long_help: Creates per-point scalar arrays named X, Y and Z from the point coordinates, so the point cloud can be colored by coordinate in the display color widget.
